source: Diablo IV Season 15 item data, verified against patch 3.2.1
uniqueAffixRule: Unique, Mythic Unique, and Iconic Mythic items have two guaranteed affixes. Other affixes can vary and one affix can be changed through Enchanting.

item:azurewrath.name: Azurewrath
item:azurewrath.uniquePower: After Freeze expires, the Frozen enemy takes [120–150]% of the damage you dealt to them while Frozen. Enemies no longer explode.

item:gohrs-devastating-grips.name: Gohr's Devastating Grips
item:gohrs-devastating-grips.uniquePower: Whirlwind deals [75–90]% increased damage and pulls enemies to you every 2 seconds.

item:melted-heart-of-selig.name: Melted Heart of Selig
item:melted-heart-of-selig.uniquePower: Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced. Your Maximum Primary Resource is increased by [58–77]% but Maximum Life is reduced by 75%.

item:rage-of-harrogath.name: Rage of Harrogath
item:rage-of-harrogath.uniquePower: Inflicting Damage Over Time on an enemy has up to a [45–60]% chance to reduce the Cooldowns of your Skills by 0.5 seconds.

item:ramaladnis-magnum-opus.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus
item:ramaladnis-magnum-opus.uniquePower: Skills deal [0.35–0.50]%[x] increased damage per point of Fury you have, but 7% of your Maximum Fury drains per second while in combat.

item:ring-of-starless-skies.name: Ring of Starless Skies
item:ring-of-starless-skies.uniquePower: Spending your Primary Resource reduces the Resource cost of your Skills and increases your damage by 10%[x] for 3 seconds, up to 50%[x].

item:the-grandfather.name: The Grandfather
item:the-grandfather.uniquePower: Increases your Critical Strike Damage by 120%[x].

item:tibaults-will.name: Tibault's Will
item:tibaults-will.uniquePower: You deal [15–20]%[x] increased damage and gain 25 Primary Resource Regeneration while Unstoppable and for 5 seconds after.

item:tuskhelm-of-joritz-the-mighty.name: Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty
item:tuskhelm-of-joritz-the-mighty.uniquePower: When you gain Berserking while already Berserk, you become more enraged, granting [40–50]%[x] increased damage, 6 Fury per second, and 10% Cooldown Reduction.
